summary.headline: Reviewed composerGate.ts (architecture). 4 tentative → 3 confirmed (1 important, 2 minor), 1 false positive. Top action: unify isRetryableConnectFailure with holepunchPolicy / docs.
top_actions: Single-source isRetryableConnectFailure: align composerGate with holepunchPolicy (or delete the unused policy helper) and point ChatRoomScreen + tests + p2pchatprotocol.md at one module
Fix @deprecated JSDoc on isComposerEnabled — prefer canSendLiveMessages / assertCanSendLive, not canComposeMessages
Optionally move COMPOSER_DISABLED_REASON / CONNECT_ERROR_HINT out of protocol into UI copy if layering is a hard rule

findings.title: Divergent duplicate isRetryableConnectFailure
findings.claim: Duplicate isRetryableConnectFailure with divergent semantics vs holepunchPolicy creates split ownership of connect-retry policy; UI uses composerGate while docs/tests assert holepunchPolicy.
findings.evidence: composerGate retries any code except crypto_mismatch (incl. undefined/aborted/expired); holepunchPolicy allowlists timeout|unreachable|unknown. ChatRoomScreen imports composerGate; docs §Connect failure/retry and composer-gate.test.ts assert holepunchPolicy, which has zero production callers.
findings.verdict_reason: Same-named helpers disagree. UI path uses the broader composerGate predicate; documented policy and tests cover holepunchPolicy. JSDoc on composerGate even states the holepunchPolicy taxonomy while implementing the broader gate.

findings.title: UI copy owned by protocol gate
findings.claim: User-facing presentation strings (COMPOSER_DISABLED_REASON / CONNECT_ERROR_HINT) are owned by the protocol service layer, mixing UI copy into protocol.
findings.evidence: English prose maps in composerGate are returned by composerDisabledReason and rendered in ChatRoomScreen; also feed assertCanSend* Error messages.
findings.verdict_reason: Presentation strings live under src/services/protocol/ while project rules prefer UI separate from protocol. Functional impact is low; cohesion of a composer-facing adapter softens but does not erase the layer mix.

findings.title: Dual import surface via re-exports
findings.claim: Thin wrappers plus barrel re-export of roomLifecycle predicates create dual import surfaces for the same send/channel rules.
findings.evidence: canComposeMessages/composerPreferredChannel wrap roomLifecycle; file also re-exports canSendLiveMessages, canSendMessages, isRelayEligibleStatus, preferredChannel.
findings.verdict_reason: Wrappers are intentional UI vocabulary aliases. Production does not import the re-exported roomLifecycle predicates from composerGate; transport/catalog import roomLifecycle directly. Unused re-exports are dead surface, not an active dual-import defect.

findings.title: Misleading deprecation target for isComposerEnabled
findings.claim: Deprecated isComposerEnabled aliases live-only canSendLiveMessages while canComposeMessages is broader relay+live, creating a misleading module API boundary.
findings.evidence: isComposerEnabled → canSendLiveMessages; canComposeMessages → canSendMessages. For accepted/connecting/connect_failed they disagree. JSDoc says prefer canComposeMessages.
findings.verdict_reason: Deprecation comment points callers at a broader predicate and would flip live-only to relay+live. Tests still treat isComposerEnabled as live-only; no production callers remain — API/docs hazard, not a live bug.
